text:
maria: CI red on main — image push failing on registry after last squash in Dockerfile. buildkite link: https://buildkite.com/rw/ci/builds/9812 — anyone able to triage?

ci-bot: build #9812 failed — push to registry.redwoodai.com/rw-runtime:main returned 403. Logs: HTTP 403: blob upload denied.

jc: I'm OOO for 2hrs, ping @kai or @sam

kai: looking. grabbing logs...

kai: log snippet:
```
INFO: pushing layer sha256:abcd...
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{"errors":[{"code":"DENIED","message":"blob upload denied"}]}
```

sam: same error on my rerun locally when I build with --squash. If I disable squash push succeeds. suspecting layer ownership/uid shift on squash step.

maria: last successful build was commit d4f3e2. The Dockerfile change that added "COPY --chown=1000:1000" was merged in PR #1287. Could be related.

kai: can someone run quick bisect? I can, but need permission to kick off canary runners. @ops-bot can you allow a canary build for kai?

ops-bot: granted temporary canary quota to @kai for 30m. Use BUILD_CANARY=true tag.

kai: thanks. I'll bisect between d4f3e2 and main and post findings.

sam: small workaround — pushing with "docker build --no-cache" changes nothing; squash seems to rewrite tar headers and preserves root ownership on some layers causing registry to reject? weird.

jc: FYI our registry enforces signed manifests by digest policy; maybe squashed layer digests conflict with mirrored layers causing DENIED. @maria any recent registry policy changes? 

maria: No policy change. But we rotated the registry token on 2026-02-09 — tokens fine. This looks like content mismatch vs existing blobs. If layer digest collides with existing blob but permissions differ, registry may deny.

kai: bisect update: commit 1e7a4f introduced "squash: enable for release builder" in CI config. Reverting that locally and pushing with squash disabled -> push succeeds. So squash + chown likely combo.

sam: propose quick fix: revert squash in release pipeline and open follow-up to investigate canonical tar headers + chown interplay. I'll open the PR.

maria: can someone rerun the failed release build after disabling squash? @kai please trigger a rebuild with BUILD_CANARY=false and SQUASH=false.

kai: triggering rebuild now: https://buildkite.com/rw/ci/builds/9814 — will update.

ci-bot: build #9814 started.

kai: build #9814 succeeded and image pushed. :tada: 

maria: great. Sam, please create the rollback PR and add to next sprint to investigate deeper. Add test case that squashed images with chown are validated.

sam: will do. Thx all. closing thread after I open PR.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-ci/pull/1302 — title "revert: disable squash for release builder (hotfix)". assigning to @jc for review.

maria: ack. good follow-up.
